content: न्यासः .²1 Placing, putting down or upon, planting, तस्या खुरन्यासपवित्रपांसुम् <ls>R. 2. 2</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 50</ls>; <ls>M. 2. 9</ls>; <ls>Māl. 5. 5</ls>; चरणन्यास, अङ्गन्यास <ab>&c.</ab>; सैन्दूरं क्रियते जनेन चरणन्यासैः पुनः कुट्टिमम् <ls>Ratn. 1. 10</ls>. .²2 Hence, any impression, mark, stamp, print; अतिशस्त्रनखन्यासः <ls>R. 12. 73</ls>; ‘where the nail-marks surpassed those of weapons’; दन्तन्यासः. .²3 Depositing. .²4 A pledge, deposit; प्रत्यर्पितन्यास इवान्तरात्मा <ls>Ś. 4. 22</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 18</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 67</ls>. .²5 Entrusting, committing, giving over, delivering, consigning. .²6 Painting, writing down. .²7 Giving up, resigning, abandoning, relinquishing; शस्त्र˚; न्यासो दण्डस्य भूतेषु <ls>Bhāg. 7. 15. 8</ls>; काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः <ls>Bg. 18. 2</ls>. .²8 Bringing forward, adducing. .²9 Digging in, seizing (as with claws). .²10 Assignment of the various parts of the body to different deities, which is usually accompanied with prayers and corresponding gesticulations. .²11 Lowering the tone or voice. .²12 संन्यास <ab>q. v.</ab>; एवं वसन् गृहे कालं विरक्तो न्यासमास्थितः <ls>Bhāg. 9. 6. 53</ls>. .²13 Written or literal text (यथान्यासम्). .²14 Bringing forward, introducing (<ab>cf.</ab> अर्थान्तरन्यास).
